# Generated by generate_aawc_stage5_packets.py; do not hand edit.
# Persistent packet API used by production native migration routing.
# Province scope. SOURCE=this; DESTINATION=province; AMOUNT=whole persons.
# One pending packet per source. Do not replace a pending packet on retry.
aawc_stage5_begin_packet_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_packet }
            exists = $DESTINATION$
            NOT = { this = $DESTINATION$ }
            $AMOUNT$ > 0
            has_variable = aawc_population_current
            var:aawc_population_current > $AMOUNT$
        }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_source
        dummy_male = {
            create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet }
        }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            set_variable = { name = source value = scope:aawc_stage5_source }
            set_variable = { name = destination value = $DESTINATION$ }
            set_variable = { name = amount value = $AMOUNT$ }
            set_variable = { name = source_population value = scope:aawc_stage5_source.var:aawc_population_current }
            set_variable = { name = phase value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = invalid value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = whole_amount value = { value = var:amount floor = yes } }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { var:whole_amount = var:amount } }
                set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
            }
            remove_variable = whole_amount
        }
        set_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_packet value = scope:aawc_stage5_packet }
        aawc_stage5_snapshot_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_snapshot_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
    }
}

# Province scope; assemble once, independently for each axis.
# Persist values, not mutable CaFG struct references. Repairs are staged only;
# the integrating transaction must initialize the missing CaFG axis on commit.
aawc_stage5_snapshot_axis_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = $TYPE$_snapshot } } }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_source
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            set_variable = { name = snapshot_count value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:aawc_stage5_source.barony.holder.$TYPE$ }
                set_variable = { name = owner_$TYPE$ value = scope:aawc_stage5_source.barony.holder.$TYPE$ }
            }
        }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_origin_struct
            dummy_male = {
                create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_row }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_row = {
                set_variable = { name = identity value = scope:aawc_stage5_origin_struct.var:$TYPE$ }
                set_variable = { name = original_factor value = scope:aawc_stage5_origin_struct.var:factor }
                set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
                aawc_stage5_snapshot_carry_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                add_to_variable_list = { name = $TYPE$_rows target = scope:aawc_stage5_row }
                change_variable = { name = snapshot_count add = 1 }
            }
        }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            if = {
                limit = { var:snapshot_count = 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = scope:aawc_stage5_source.county.$TYPE$ }
                    dummy_male = {
                        create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_row }
                    }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_row = {
                        set_variable = { name = identity value = scope:aawc_stage5_source.county.$TYPE$ }
                        set_variable = { name = original_factor value = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
                        aawc_stage5_snapshot_carry_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = $TYPE$_rows target = scope:aawc_stage5_row }
                    set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_repair value = 1 }
                }
                else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
            }
            set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_snapshot value = 1 }
            remove_variable = snapshot_count
        }
    }
}

# Row scope. Source-owned carry records are keyed by identity, independently
# of CaFG struct lifetime. Duplicate records fail closed instead of list-order wins.
aawc_stage5_snapshot_carry_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_row
    set_variable = { name = departure_carry value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = carry_matches value = 0 }
    scope:aawc_stage5_source = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = aawc_stage5_$TYPE$_carries
            limit = { var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_row.var:identity }
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_carry
            scope:aawc_stage5_row = {
                set_variable = { name = departure_carry value = scope:aawc_stage5_carry.var:value }
                change_variable = { name = carry_matches add = 1 }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:carry_matches > 1 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
    remove_variable = carry_matches
}

# Packet scope; known identity quantities are set, never added on retry.
# Reject unknown identities and malformed quantities before any absolute debit.
aawc_stage5_set_packet_quantity_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        set_variable = { name = matched value = 0 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            limit = { var:identity = $IDENTITY$ }
            set_variable = { name = quantity value = $QUANTITY$ }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_explicit value = 1 } }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = matched add = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { NOT = { var:matched = 1 } $QUANTITY$ < 0 } }
            set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
        }
        remove_variable = matched
    }
}

# Packet scope. Revalidate persisted vectors against frozen source masses.
# A sealed packet cannot be edited. Phase 1 means provenance sealed, NOT debited.
aawc_stage5_seal_packet_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:invalid = 0
                var:culture_total = var:amount
                var:faith_total = var:amount
            }
            set_variable = { name = phase value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_total value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_factor_total value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        set_variable = { name = whole_quantity value = { value = var:quantity floor = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { var:whole_quantity = var:quantity } }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        }
        remove_variable = whole_quantity
        set_variable = { name = available value = var:original_factor }
        change_variable = { name = available multiply = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:quantity < 0 var:quantity > var:available var:original_factor < 0 } }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            change_variable = { name = $TYPE$_total add = prev.var:quantity }
            change_variable = { name = $TYPE$_factor_total add = prev.var:original_factor }
        }
        remove_variable = available
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:$TYPE$_factor_total = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
    }
}

# Province scope. Cancel only uncommitted staging; never discard in-flight debt.
aawc_stage5_cancel_staging_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = aawc_stage5_packet
            var:aawc_stage5_packet = { var:phase < 2 }
        }
        var:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            every_in_list = { variable = culture_rows end_story = yes }
            every_in_list = { variable = faith_rows end_story = yes }
            end_story = yes
        }
        remove_variable = aawc_stage5_packet
    }
}


# Packet scope; explicit caller-supplied canonical rank, not a localized name.
aawc_stage5_set_identity_rank_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 $RANK$ > 0 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            limit = { var:identity = $IDENTITY$ }
            set_variable = { name = rank value = $RANK$ }
        }
    }
}

# Packet scope. Require unique positive whole ranks before any tie-breaking.
aawc_stage5_validate_ranks_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_rank_row
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rank } }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = whole_rank value = { value = var:rank floor = yes } }
            if = {
                limit = { OR = { var:rank <= 0 NOT = { var:rank = var:whole_rank } } }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = $TYPE$_rows
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { this = scope:aawc_stage5_rank_row }
                        has_variable = rank
                        var:rank = scope:aawc_stage5_rank_row.var:rank
                    }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = whole_rank
        }
    }
}

# Packet scope; independently fill only an entirely unspecified axis.
# This never substitutes destination identities or overwrites explicit vectors.
aawc_stage5_resolve_missing_axis_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 NOT = { has_variable = $TYPE$_explicit } }
        aawc_stage5_validate_ranks_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
        remove_variable = selected_row
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:original_factor > 0 }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_row } } }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            var:original_factor > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:original_factor
                            AND = {
                                var:original_factor = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:original_factor
                                var:rank < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:rank
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = selected_row var:invalid = 0 }
            var:selected_row = { set_variable = { name = quantity value = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount } }
            set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_fallback value = var:selected_row.var:identity }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        remove_variable = selected_row
    }
}

# Packet scope; precompute both source axes before permitting absolute debit.
# All intermediate values are persisted on packet rows, never CaFG structs.
aawc_stage5_prepare_source_debit_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 1 var:invalid = 0 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        set_variable = { name = remaining_population value = var:source_population }
        change_variable = { name = remaining_population subtract = var:amount }
        if = {
            limit = { var:remaining_population > 0 }
            aawc_stage5_prepare_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
            aawc_stage5_prepare_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
            if = {
                limit = { var:invalid = 0 }
                set_variable = { name = source_prepared value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_prepare_source_axis_effect = {
    aawc_stage5_validate_ranks_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        set_variable = { name = mass value = var:original_factor }
        change_variable = { name = mass multiply = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population }
        change_variable = { name = mass subtract = var:quantity }
        if = {
            limit = { var:mass < 0 }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:invalid = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_normalize_rows_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ DENOMINATOR = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:remaining_population }
    }
}

# Packet scope. Fixed-point Hamilton normalization and deterministic absorption.
# Input mass rows and positive denominator; output factor units sum to 100000.
# At most one remainder award per row. No dependency random conversion path.
aawc_stage5_normalize_rows_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    set_variable = { name = units_left value = 100000 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        set_variable = { name = quota value = var:mass }
        change_variable = { name = quota multiply = 100000 }
        change_variable = { name = quota divide = $DENOMINATOR$ }
        set_variable = { name = units value = { value = var:quota floor = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = remainder value = var:quota }
        change_variable = { name = remainder subtract = var:units }
        set_variable = { name = awarded value = 0 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = units_left subtract = prev.var:units } }
    }
    while = {
        limit = { var:units_left > 0 var:invalid = 0 }
        remove_variable = selected_row
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            limit = { var:awarded = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_row } } }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:remainder > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:remainder
                        AND = {
                            var:remainder = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:remainder
                            OR = {
                                var:quota > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:quota
                                AND = {
                                    var:quota = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:quota
                                    var:rank < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:rank
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = selected_row }
            var:selected_row = {
                change_variable = { name = units add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = awarded value = 1 }
            }
            change_variable = { name = units_left subtract = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
    remove_variable = selected_row
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_row } } }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:units > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:units
                    AND = {
                        var:units = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:units
                        var:rank < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:rank
                    }
                }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = absorbed_units value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        limit = { NOT = { this = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row } var:units < 500 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = absorbed_units add = prev.var:units } }
        set_variable = { name = units value = 0 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = selected_row }
        var:selected_row = { change_variable = { name = units add = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:absorbed_units } }
    }
    set_variable = { name = normalized_total value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        set_variable = { name = new_factor value = var:units }
        change_variable = { name = new_factor divide = 100000 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = normalized_total add = prev.var:units } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:normalized_total = 100000 } }
        set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
    }
    remove_variable = selected_row
}

# Packet scope. Called ONLY after an exact Stage 4 absolute source receipt.
# Population equality is an additional guard, not a substitute for that receipt.
aawc_stage5_apply_source_debit_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 2
            var:source_prepared = 1
            var:invalid = 0
            var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:remaining_population }
        }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        aawc_stage5_write_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_write_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        aawc_stage5_commit_carries_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_commit_carries_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        set_variable = { name = phase value = 3 }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

aawc_stage5_write_source_axis_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_write_row
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source = {
            E_kCAFG_set_struct_factor = {
                TYPE = $TYPE$
                SCOPE = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:identity
                FACTOR = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:new_factor
            }
        }
    }
}


# Packet scope; destination_{culture,faith}_rows contain the union of existing
# destination identities and packet identities (including zero-factor entries).
# The caller snapshots destination_population before its absolute receipt.
aawc_stage5_prepare_destination_credit_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:phase = 1 var:phase = 3 } var:invalid = 0 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        remove_variable = destination_prepared
        set_variable = { name = whole_destination_population value = { value = var:destination_population floor = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:destination_population < 0
                    NOT = { var:destination_population = var:whole_destination_population }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = credited_population value = var:destination_population }
        change_variable = { name = credited_population add = var:amount }
        aawc_stage5_prepare_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_prepare_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        if = {
            limit = { var:invalid = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = destination_prepared value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_prepare_destination_axis_effect = {
    aawc_stage5_validate_ranks_effect = { TYPE = destination_$TYPE$ }
    set_variable = { name = destination_factor_total value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = destination_quantity_total value = 0 }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = destination_$TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_destination_row
        set_variable = { name = matched_quantity value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = matches value = 0 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = $TYPE$_rows
                limit = { var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_destination_row.var:identity }
                scope:aawc_stage5_destination_row = {
                    set_variable = { name = matched_quantity value = prev.var:quantity }
                    change_variable = { name = matches add = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:matches > 1
                    var:original_factor < 0
                    var:quantity < 0
                    NOT = { var:quantity = var:matched_quantity }
                }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
        }
        # Duplicate identities invalidate even if ranks differ.
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = destination_$TYPE$_rows
                limit = {
                    NOT = { this = scope:aawc_stage5_destination_row }
                    var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_destination_row.var:identity
                }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = mass value = var:original_factor }
        change_variable = { name = mass multiply = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination_population }
        change_variable = { name = mass add = var:quantity }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            change_variable = { name = destination_factor_total add = prev.var:original_factor }
            change_variable = { name = destination_quantity_total add = prev.var:quantity }
        }
        remove_variable = matched_quantity
        remove_variable = matches
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { var:destination_quantity_total = var:amount }
                AND = { var:destination_population > 0 NOT = { var:destination_factor_total = 1 } }
                AND = {
                    var:destination_population = 0
                    NOT = { var:destination_factor_total = 0 }
                    NOT = { var:destination_factor_total = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:invalid = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_normalize_rows_effect = {
            TYPE = destination_$TYPE$
            DENOMINATOR = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:credited_population
        }
    }
}

# Phase 4 is set ONLY by a successful exact absolute credit receipt.
aawc_stage5_apply_destination_credit_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 4 var:invalid = 0 var:destination_prepared = 1
            var:destination = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:credited_population }
        }
        aawc_stage5_write_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_write_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        set_variable = { name = phase value = 5 }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

aawc_stage5_write_destination_axis_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = destination_$TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_write_row
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination = {
            E_kCAFG_set_struct_factor = {
                TYPE = $TYPE$
                SCOPE = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:identity
                FACTOR = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:new_factor
            }
        }
    }
}

# Caller holds source identity/absolute lock throughout an unsettled packet.
# Prepare rollback only while source population AND both applied axes still
# match the post-debit state. A divergent source requires recovery, not overwrite.
aawc_stage5_prepare_refund_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    remove_variable = refund_prepared
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 3
            var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:remaining_population }
        }
        set_variable = { name = refund_stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_refund_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_check_refund_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        if = {
            limit = { var:refund_stale = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = refund_prepared value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_check_refund_axis_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = refund_factor_total value = 0 }
    # Check both directions: otherwise duplicate live structs could conceal a
    # missing identity while still presenting a normalized total.
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_refund_row
        set_variable = { name = live_matches value = 0 }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
                limit = { var:$TYPE$ = scope:aawc_stage5_refund_row.var:identity }
                scope:aawc_stage5_refund_row = { change_variable = { name = live_matches add = 1 } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:live_matches > 1
                    AND = { var:new_factor > 0 NOT = { var:live_matches = 1 } }
                }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = refund_stale value = 1 } }
        }
        remove_variable = live_matches
    }
    var:source = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_live_struct
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                change_variable = { name = refund_factor_total add = prev.var:factor }
                set_variable = { name = refund_matches value = 0 }
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = $TYPE$_rows
                    limit = {
                        var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:$TYPE$
                        var:new_factor = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:factor
                    }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = refund_matches add = 1 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { var:refund_matches = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = refund_stale value = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { var:refund_factor_total = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = refund_stale value = 1 }
    }
}

# Phase 6 is set ONLY by an exact AAWC absolute refund receipt after preparation.
# Restoring snapshots also restores any units absorbed during normalization.
# Destination failure must not prevent refund: invalid is intentionally ignored.
aawc_stage5_apply_refund_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 6 var:refund_prepared = 1
            var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population }
        }
        aawc_stage5_restore_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_restore_source_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        set_variable = { name = phase value = 7 }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

aawc_stage5_restore_source_axis_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_write_row
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source = {
            E_kCAFG_set_struct_factor = {
                TYPE = $TYPE$
                SCOPE = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:identity
                FACTOR = scope:aawc_stage5_write_row.var:original_factor
            }
        }
    }
}


# Packet scope. Explicit/fallback provenance must never be reweighted.
# Owner identities and carries are snapshot inputs, never live reads on retry.
aawc_stage5_weight_departures_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 0 var:invalid = 0
            NOT = { has_variable = $TYPE$_explicit }
            NOT = { has_variable = $TYPE$_fallback }
            NOT = { has_variable = $TYPE$_weighted }
        }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        aawc_stage5_validate_ranks_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
        aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
        set_variable = { name = departure_capacity value = 0 }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            set_variable = { name = capacity value = var:original_factor }
            change_variable = { name = capacity multiply = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population }
            set_variable = { name = score value = var:capacity }
            set_variable = { name = capacity value = { value = var:capacity floor = yes } }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = owner_$TYPE$ } }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:owner_$TYPE$ }
                    change_variable = { name = score multiply = 0.5 }
                }
                else = { change_variable = { name = score multiply = 2 } }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = departure_carry } }
                set_variable = { name = departure_carry value = 0 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = next_carry value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = active value = 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:capacity > 0 }
                set_variable = { name = active value = 1 }
            }
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = departure_capacity add = prev.var:capacity } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:departure_capacity < var:amount }
            set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = departure_left value = var:amount }
        while = {
            limit = { var:departure_left > 0 var:invalid = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = score_total value = 0 }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = $TYPE$_rows
                limit = { var:active = 1 }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = score_total add = prev.var:score } }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:score_total <= 0 }
                set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = saturated value = 0 }
                # Compute ALL quotas before reducing remaining demand.
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = $TYPE$_rows
                    limit = { var:active = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = departure_quota value = var:score }
                    change_variable = { name = departure_quota multiply = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:departure_left }
                    change_variable = { name = departure_quota divide = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:score_total }
                    change_variable = { name = departure_quota add = var:departure_carry }
                }
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = $TYPE$_rows
                    limit = { var:active = 1 var:departure_quota >= var:capacity }
                    set_variable = { name = quantity value = var:capacity }
                    set_variable = { name = active value = 0 }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                        set_variable = { name = saturated value = 1 }
                        change_variable = { name = departure_left subtract = prev.var:quantity }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:saturated = 0 }
                    set_variable = { name = allocated value = 0 }
                    every_in_list = {
                        variable = $TYPE$_rows
                        limit = { var:active = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = quantity value = { value = var:departure_quota floor = yes } }
                        if = {
                            limit = { var:quantity < 0 }
                            set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
                        }
                        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = allocated add = prev.var:quantity } }
                    }
                    aawc_stage5_correct_departures_up_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
                    aawc_stage5_correct_departures_down_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ }
                    every_in_list = {
                        variable = $TYPE$_rows
                        limit = { var:active = 1 }
                        set_variable = { name = next_carry value = var:departure_quota }
                        change_variable = { name = next_carry subtract = var:quantity }
                    }
                    set_variable = { name = departure_left value = 0 }
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { var:invalid = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_weighted value = 1 }
            # A fully prepared vector is now explicit provenance for fallback.
            set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_explicit value = 1 }
        }
        remove_variable = selected_row
    }
}

aawc_stage5_correct_departures_up_effect = {
    while = {
        limit = { var:allocated < var:departure_left var:invalid = 0 }
        remove_variable = selected_row
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            limit = { var:active = 1 var:quantity < var:capacity }
            set_variable = { name = entitlement value = var:departure_quota }
            change_variable = { name = entitlement subtract = var:quantity }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_row } } }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:entitlement > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:entitlement
                        AND = {
                            var:entitlement = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:entitlement
                            var:rank < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:rank
                        }
                    }
                }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = selected_row }
            var:selected_row = { change_variable = { name = quantity add = 1 } }
            change_variable = { name = allocated add = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_correct_departures_down_effect = {
    while = {
        limit = { var:allocated > var:departure_left var:invalid = 0 }
        remove_variable = selected_row
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            limit = { var:active = 1 var:quantity > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = entitlement value = var:departure_quota }
            change_variable = { name = entitlement subtract = var:quantity }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_row } } }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        var:entitlement < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:entitlement
                        AND = {
                            var:entitlement = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:entitlement
                            var:rank < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_row.var:rank
                        }
                    }
                }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_row value = prev } }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = selected_row }
            var:selected_row = { change_variable = { name = quantity subtract = 1 } }
            change_variable = { name = allocated subtract = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
}


# Packet scope. Inputs are frozen candidate stories, never mutable live scores.
# A route receipt survives retries. Empty search changes no population or carries.
aawc_stage5_select_route_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 var:invalid = 0 NOT = { has_variable = route_prepared } }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        remove_variable = selected_candidate
        every_in_list = {
            variable = route_candidates
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_candidate
            set_variable = { name = eligible value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = identity_match value = 0 }
            aawc_stage5_match_candidate_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
            aawc_stage5_match_candidate_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
            if = {
                limit = { var:adjacent = 1 var:receive_capacity >= scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount }
                if = {
                    limit = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_war = 0 var:war = 0 var:identity_match = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = eligible value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = tier value = 1 }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_war = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = eligible value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = tier value = 4 }
                    if = {
                        limit = { var:war = 0 }
                        set_variable = { name = tier value = 2 }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { var:identity_match = 1 }
                        change_variable = { name = tier subtract = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { var:eligible = 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { has_variable = selected_candidate } } }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_candidate value = prev } }
                }
                else = { aawc_stage5_compare_candidate_effect = yes }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = selected_candidate }
            set_variable = { name = destination value = var:selected_candidate.var:destination }
            set_variable = { name = route_prepared value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# Candidate scope: OR across independent axes, positive packet quantities only.
aawc_stage5_match_candidate_axis_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        limit = { var:original_factor >= 0.005 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_destination_identity
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = $TYPE$_rows
                limit = { var:quantity > 0 var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_destination_identity.var:identity }
                scope:aawc_stage5_candidate = { set_variable = { name = identity_match value = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_compare_candidate_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { AND = {  var:tier < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:tier }
AND = { var:tier = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:tier var:rating_delta > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:rating_delta }
AND = { var:tier = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:tier var:rating_delta = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:rating_delta var:receive_capacity > scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:receive_capacity }
AND = { var:tier = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:tier var:rating_delta = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:rating_delta var:receive_capacity = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:receive_capacity var:province_id < scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:selected_candidate.var:province_id } } }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = selected_candidate value = prev } }
    }
}


# Packet scope; assembler supplies canonical ranks and frozen candidates first.
# ORDINARY=1 creates weighted provenance. ORDINARY=0 preserves known quantities
# and independently resolves missing axes from the source majority.
aawc_stage5_prepare_identity_route_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 0 var:invalid = 0 }
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
        if = {
            limit = { $ORDINARY$ = 1 }
            aawc_stage5_weight_departures_effect = { TYPE = culture }
            aawc_stage5_weight_departures_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        }
        aawc_stage5_resolve_missing_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_resolve_missing_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_validate_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        if = {
            limit = { var:invalid = 0 var:culture_total = var:amount var:faith_total = var:amount }
            aawc_stage5_select_route_effect = yes
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = route_prepared }
                aawc_stage5_seal_packet_effect = yes
                aawc_stage5_prepare_source_debit_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# Packet scope, called inside the successful exact source-debit receipt guard.
# The source lock belongs to the transaction caller. Weighted axes alone advance
# residuals; explicit/fallback packets must not consume ordinary-stream carries.
aawc_stage5_commit_carries_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = $TYPE$_weighted NOT = { has_variable = $TYPE$_carries_committed } }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $TYPE$_rows
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_carry_row
            aawc_stage5_store_carry_effect = { TYPE = $TYPE$ VALUE = scope:aawc_stage5_carry_row.var:next_carry }
        }
        set_variable = { name = $TYPE$_carries_committed value = 1 }
    }
}

# Row scope. Source-owned stories outlive the packet and the CaFG structs.
# Snapshot validation rejects duplicate identity records before reservation.
aawc_stage5_store_carry_effect = {
    remove_variable = carry_record
    scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = aawc_stage5_$TYPE$_carries
            limit = { var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_carry_row.var:identity }
            scope:aawc_stage5_carry_row = { set_variable = { name = carry_record value = prev } }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = carry_record } }
        dummy_male = { create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_new_carry } }
        scope:aawc_stage5_new_carry = { set_variable = { name = identity value = scope:aawc_stage5_carry_row.var:identity } }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source = {
            add_to_variable_list = { name = aawc_stage5_$TYPE$_carries target = scope:aawc_stage5_new_carry }
        }
        set_variable = { name = carry_record value = scope:aawc_stage5_new_carry }
    }
    var:carry_record = { set_variable = { name = value value = $VALUE$ } }
    remove_variable = carry_record
}


# Packet scope. Canonical registry ranks must already exist on source rows and
# destination-only identities. Snapshot the UNION, never discard destination
# minorities or manufacture an identity from destination ownership.
aawc_stage5_snapshot_destination_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = destination_snapshot } exists = var:destination }
        set_variable = { name = destination_population value = var:destination.var:aawc_population_current }
        aawc_stage5_snapshot_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture }
        aawc_stage5_snapshot_destination_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith }
        set_variable = { name = destination_snapshot value = 1 }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_snapshot_destination_axis_effect = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = $TYPE$_rows
        save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_origin_row
        dummy_male = { create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_row } }
        scope:aawc_stage5_row = {
            set_variable = { name = identity value = scope:aawc_stage5_origin_row.var:identity }
            set_variable = { name = rank value = scope:aawc_stage5_origin_row.var:rank }
            set_variable = { name = quantity value = scope:aawc_stage5_origin_row.var:quantity }
            set_variable = { name = original_factor value = 0 }
        }
        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { add_to_variable_list = { name = destination_$TYPE$_rows target = scope:aawc_stage5_row } }
    }
    var:destination = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_live_struct
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                remove_variable = union_match
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = destination_$TYPE$_rows
                    limit = { var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:$TYPE$ }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = union_match value = prev } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = union_match } }
                    dummy_male = { create_story = { type = aawc_stage5_packet_record save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_row } }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_row = {
                        set_variable = { name = identity value = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:$TYPE$ }
                        set_variable = { name = quantity value = 0 }
                        set_variable = { name = original_factor value = 0 }
                        if = {
                            limit = { var:identity = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_rank } }
                            set_variable = { name = rank value = var:identity.var:aawc_stage5_identity_rank }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = destination_$TYPE$_rows target = scope:aawc_stage5_row }
                    set_variable = { name = union_match value = scope:aawc_stage5_row }
                }
                var:union_match = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = live_seen }
                        scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
                    }
                    set_variable = { name = original_factor value = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:factor }
                    set_variable = { name = live_seen value = 1 }
                }
                remove_variable = union_match
            }
        }
    }
}

# Generic bidirectional stale-state guard. Extra/duplicate live structs and
# vanished positive rows are rejected. Empty-source repairs are accepted only
# while that live axis is still empty; they are written on commit, not staging.
aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = live_count value = 0 }
    $PROVINCE$ = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_live_struct
            scope:aawc_stage5_packet = {
                change_variable = { name = live_count add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = live_matches value = 0 }
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = $ROWS$_rows
                    limit = {
                        var:identity = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:$TYPE$
                        var:$FACTOR$ = scope:aawc_stage5_live_struct.var:factor
                    }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { change_variable = { name = live_matches add = 1 } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { var:live_matches = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = stale value = 1 }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { AND = { $REPAIR$ = 1 var:live_count = 0 } } }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = $ROWS$_rows
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_checked_row
            set_variable = { name = live_matches value = 0 }
            $PROVINCE$ = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = kCAFG_province_$TYPE$_structs
                    limit = { var:$TYPE$ = scope:aawc_stage5_checked_row.var:identity }
                    scope:aawc_stage5_checked_row = { change_variable = { name = live_matches add = 1 } }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { OR = {
                    var:live_matches > 1
                    AND = { var:$FACTOR$ > 0 NOT = { var:live_matches = 1 } }
                } }
                scope:aawc_stage5_packet = { set_variable = { name = stale value = 1 } }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Packet scope. Both endpoints are locked before any absolute debit. A packet
# story IS the persistent transaction identifier; no date/amount pseudo-ID.
aawc_stage5_reserve_transaction_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:phase = 1 var:invalid = 0 var:source_prepared = 1
            has_variable = route_prepared
            NOT = { has_variable = transaction_reserved }
            exists = var:source exists = var:destination
            NOT = { var:source = var:destination }
            var:source = {
                NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock }
                var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population
                aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
                aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1
                aawc_stage4_unreserved_civilian_total >= scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount
                has_variable = aawc_migration_holding_protective_floor
                var:aawc_migration_holding_protective_floor <= scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:remaining_population
            }
            var:destination = {
                NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock }
                aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
                aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1
            }
        }
        aawc_stage5_snapshot_destination_effect = yes
        aawc_stage5_prepare_destination_credit_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_source_snapshot_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = { var:invalid = 0 var:stale = 0 has_variable = destination_prepared }
            var:source = { set_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_identity_lock value = scope:aawc_stage5_packet } }
            var:destination = { set_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_identity_lock value = scope:aawc_stage5_packet } }
            set_variable = { name = transaction_reserved value = 1 }
            add_to_global_variable_list = { name = aawc_stage5_pending_packets target = this }
        }
    }
}

aawc_stage5_check_source_snapshot_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = repair_allowed value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = culture_repair } set_variable = { name = repair_allowed value = 1 } }
    aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture ROWS = culture FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source REPAIR = var:repair_allowed }
    set_variable = { name = repair_allowed value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = faith_repair } set_variable = { name = repair_allowed value = 1 } }
    aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith ROWS = faith FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source REPAIR = var:repair_allowed }
}

# Exact AAWC age-band debit. The pool belongs to THIS packet, not a county.
# Phase is changed in the same synchronous effect as its absolute receipt.
aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_source_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 1 var:invalid = 0 has_variable = transaction_reserved }
        set_variable = { name = stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_source_snapshot_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:stale = 0
                var:source = {
                    var:aawc_stage5_identity_lock = scope:aawc_stage5_packet
                    var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population
                    aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1
                    aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
                    aawc_stage4_unreserved_civilian_total >= scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = aawc_reforging_transfer_pool_owner
            aawc_reforging_cohort_reset_transfer_pool_effect = yes
            var:source = {
                aawc_reforging_cohort_capture_transfer_packet_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount }
            }
            set_variable = { name = absolute_debited value = var:source.var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_transfer_debit }
            if = {
                limit = { var:absolute_debited = var:amount var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:remaining_population } }
                set_variable = { name = phase value = 2 }
            }
            else = {
                # An unexpected partial debit has no identity debt. Restore the
                # actual captured bands immediately; never credit a destination.
                var:source = { aawc_reforging_cohort_apply_transfer_packet_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:absolute_debited } }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population } }
                    set_variable = { name = phase value = 7 }
                }
                else = { set_variable = { name = phase value = 8 } }
                set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = invalid value = 1 } }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

# Packet scope. Check the frozen destination before using the exact age pool.
# Failure after source debt requests the existing guarded inverse, never a new
# packet or freshly recomputed provenance.
aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_destination_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 3 var:invalid = 0 NOT = { has_variable = abort_requested } }
        set_variable = { name = stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture ROWS = destination_culture FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination REPAIR = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith ROWS = destination_faith FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination REPAIR = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_pool_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:stale = 0 var:pool_total = var:amount
                var:destination = {
                    var:aawc_stage5_identity_lock = scope:aawc_stage5_packet
                    var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination_population
                    aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
                    aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = aawc_reforging_transfer_pool_owner
            var:destination = { aawc_reforging_cohort_apply_transfer_packet_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount } }
            set_variable = { name = absolute_credited value = var:destination.var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_transfer_credit }
            if = {
                limit = { var:absolute_credited = var:amount var:destination = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:credited_population } }
                set_variable = { name = phase value = 4 }
            }
            else = {
                # Preserve payload and receipts for repair; never replay a
                # partial absolute credit or refund residents already delivered.
                set_variable = { name = phase value = 8 }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = abort_requested value = 1 } }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_refund_effect = {
    set_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet value = this }
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 3 OR = { var:invalid = 1 has_variable = abort_requested } }
        aawc_stage5_prepare_refund_effect = yes
        aawc_stage5_check_pool_effect = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = refund_prepared var:pool_total = var:amount
                var:source = {
                    var:aawc_stage5_identity_lock = scope:aawc_stage5_packet
                    aawc_population_valid_settlement_for_cohort_trigger = yes
                    aawc_reforging_round_counts_valid_value = 1
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = aawc_reforging_transfer_pool_owner
            var:source = { aawc_reforging_cohort_apply_transfer_packet_effect = { AMOUNT = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:amount } }
            set_variable = { name = absolute_refunded value = var:source.var:aawc_reforging_cohort_last_transfer_credit }
            if = {
                limit = { var:absolute_refunded = var:amount var:source = { var:aawc_population_current = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:source_population } }
                set_variable = { name = phase value = 6 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = phase value = 8 } }
        }
    }
    remove_global_variable = aawc_stage5_mutating_packet
}

# Receipt replay is safe at each persisted boundary; terminal packets no-op.
aawc_stage5_execute_transaction_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    aawc_stage5_reserve_transaction_effect = yes
    aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_source_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 2 has_variable = transaction_reserved }
        set_variable = { name = stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_source_snapshot_effect = yes
        if = { limit = { var:stale = 0 } aawc_stage5_apply_source_debit_effect = yes }
    }
    aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_destination_effect = yes
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 4 has_variable = transaction_reserved }
        set_variable = { name = stale value = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = culture ROWS = destination_culture FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination REPAIR = 0 }
        aawc_stage5_check_live_axis_effect = { TYPE = faith ROWS = destination_faith FACTOR = original_factor PROVINCE = scope:aawc_stage5_packet.var:destination REPAIR = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:stale = 0 } aawc_stage5_apply_destination_credit_effect = yes }
    }
    aawc_stage5_commit_absolute_refund_effect = yes
    aawc_stage5_apply_refund_effect = yes
    aawc_stage5_finish_transaction_effect = yes
}

# Queue once, after terminal reconciliation. Refunds also require a refresh
# because source setters may have repaired an empty axis.
aawc_stage5_finish_transaction_effect = {
    save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { var:phase = 5 var:phase = 7 } NOT = { has_variable = finished } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:phase = 5 }
            var:destination.county = { aawc_stage5_queue_county_effect = yes }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { var:phase = 5 has_variable = refund_prepared } }
            var:source.county = { aawc_stage5_queue_county_effect = yes }
        }
        aawc_stage5_unlock_transaction_effect = yes
        set_variable = { name = finished value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { var:phase = 1 var:invalid = 1 has_variable = transaction_reserved }
        aawc_stage5_unlock_transaction_effect = yes
    }
}

aawc_stage5_unlock_transaction_effect = {
    var:source = {
        if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage5_identity_lock ?= scope:aawc_stage5_packet } remove_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock }
    }
    var:destination = {
        if = { limit = { var:aawc_stage5_identity_lock ?= scope:aawc_stage5_packet } remove_variable = aawc_stage5_identity_lock }
    }
    remove_list_global_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_pending_packets target = this }
}

aawc_stage5_queue_county_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aawc_stage5_refresh_queued } }
        set_variable = { name = aawc_stage5_refresh_queued value = 1 }
        add_to_global_variable_list = { name = aawc_stage5_changed_counties target = this }
    }
}

# End of the demographic/migration batch. The list is sparse and persistent;
# no every_county/every_province fallback, no per-transfer refresh.
aawc_stage5_flush_counties_effect = {
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = aawc_stage5_changed_counties
        aawc_population_reaggregate_county_cached_effect = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_county_cultures_list = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_county_faiths_list = yes
        E_kCAFG_update_county_culture = { REASON = flag:migration }
        E_kCAFG_update_county_faith = { REASON = flag:migration }
        remove_variable = aawc_stage5_refresh_queued
    }
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = aawc_stage5_changed_counties
        holder = { aawc_population_reaggregate_character_cached_effect = yes }
    }
    clear_global_variable_list = aawc_stage5_changed_counties
}

aawc_stage5_recover_pending_effect = {
    every_in_global_list = {
        variable = aawc_stage5_pending_packets
        aawc_stage5_execute_transaction_effect = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = migration_receipt } aawc_stage5_account_migration_receipt_effect = yes }
        var:source = { aawc_stage5_cleanup_packet_effect = yes }
    }
}

# Source province scope. The scheduler consumes the terminal receipt/budgets
# BEFORE cleanup. Unsettled phases, exact age pools and locks are never erased.
aawc_stage5_cleanup_packet_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = aawc_stage5_packet
            var:aawc_stage5_packet = { OR = { var:phase < 2 has_variable = finished } }
        }
        var:aawc_stage5_packet = {
            save_scope_as = aawc_stage5_packet
            if = { limit = { has_variable = transaction_reserved } aawc_stage5_unlock_transaction_effect = yes }
            every_in_list = { variable = culture_rows end_story = yes }
            every_in_list = { variable = faith_rows end_story = yes }
            every_in_list = { variable = destination_culture_rows end_story = yes }
            every_in_list = { variable = destination_faith_rows end_story = yes }
            every_in_list = {
                variable = route_candidates
                every_in_list = { variable = culture_rows end_story = yes }
                every_in_list = { variable = faith_rows end_story = yes }
                end_story = yes
            }
            end_story = yes
        }
        remove_variable = aawc_stage5_packet
    }
}

aawc_stage5_check_pool_effect = {
    set_variable = { name = pool_total value = 0 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_00_04 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_05_09 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_10_14 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_15_19 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_20_24 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_25_29 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_30_34 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_35_39 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_40_44 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_45_49 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_50_54 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_55_59 }
    change_variable = { name = pool_total add = var:aawc_reforging_transfer_age_60_plus }
}
